articles.readerDecision: Commit capital against usable power and operating conditions

coverage.scope: Full editorial and scenario review; targeted primary-source reverification, not every listed source independently refreshed.

evidence.result: Financial formulas are supported. Additional minimum-billing security, staged release and material-change restudy are consequential omitted mechanisms.

findings.issue: The four-account framework omits the minimum-billing commitment and associated possible extra security. Security return does not happen wholly at energization. A facility ramp and an exit can therefore change both liquidity and nonrefundable exposure.
findings.proposedEdit: Add the minimum-billing obligation as a distinct contractual/tariff input. The rule requires an acknowledgment and permits additional related security; it releases 20% at energization and the remaining amounts against agreement milestones. Obtain the actual §25.193 treatment and SLLIA before pricing duration or withdrawal liability.

findings.issue: The article names liquidity but never converts the $2M difference in security into a comparable cost against $1.2M permanent CIAC. Readers may still compare nominal dollars of different economic character.
findings.proposedEdit: Declare an illustrative 4% annual net financing spread, after collateral interest, and three-year hold. The extra $2M collateral costs $240,000 on that simplified basis, versus $1.2M extra permanent CIAC at B. The 15-year simple break-even hold is an analytical boundary, not a projected release date. Then make delay, exit amounts and staged release separate sensitivities.

findings.issue: Changing phase, load composition or requested demand can restart the request, rather than merely update an internal model.
findings.proposedEdit: Add the §25.194(e)(4) material-change mechanism beside the change-control recommendation; have the utility identify whether a cooling or ramp redesign requires a new request before committing to the revised plan.

calculationChecks.new: 2M×.04×3=$240,000; 1.2M/(2M×.04)=15 years; assumed simple net carrying cost, no tax or release path.

limitations: No effective §25.193 tariff amount/duration or project-specific SLLIA independently obtained. Do not invent minimum bills or final program participation.
